name: script_walk_to_mark
about: A scripted_sequence walks its NPC to the mark, plays, fires its outputs and lets it go (docs/specs/0003-scripted-sequence/spec.md § Witness data, recovered 2026-09-12). sm_vamparena's sVamp_entrance (m_fMoveTo 1, m_iszPlay pre_fight_bow, no idle or post-idle, no spawnflags, OnBeginSequence -> AsianVamp.SetRelationship 'player D_HT 5') and its target AsianVamp (npc_VAsianVampire, D_NU 0, 281 cm off), verbatim. BeginSequence 0x101a7390 -> PossessEntity (CCineNPC 0x101a7880): m_scriptState +0x5d70 = 4, DelayStart(1), ideal state NPC_STATE_SCRIPT; SelectSchedule 0x1028a380 case 4 -> SCHED_AISCRIPT 0x2e, TranslateSchedule 0x102cc080 / 0x102b12f0 -> SCHED_TROIKA_SCRIPTED_WALK 0xf2 (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_scripted_walk.sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE, SET_TOLERANCE_DISTANCE 2, WALK_TO_TARGET, WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, PLANT_ON_SCRIPT, FACE_SCRIPT, ENABLE_SCRIPT, WAIT_FOR_SCRIPT, PLAY_SCRIPT, PLAY_SCRIPT_POST_IDLE). OnBeginSequence fires from TASK_WAIT_FOR_SCRIPT's run arm when IsTimeToStart 0x101a7540 holds (on the mark, not at the input), then StartSequence(m_iszPlay); TASK_PLAY_SCRIPT waits m_bSequenceFinished -> SequenceDone 0x101a8460 -> Finish 0x101a8640 (no post-idle) and OnEndSequence fires unconditionally; CineCleanup 0x1027d170 sets the ideal state IDLE and FixScriptNPCSchedule 0x101a8840 clears the schedule, so the NPC selects again — here, hostile once OnBeginSequence's wire lands, a combat program. Corrected 2026-10-04 (V3c integrator, record errors): (1) m_iszPlay 'pre_fight_bow' is a content miss -- AsianVampire.mdl spells it 'prefight_bow' (docs/vtmb/entity_io.md:2471, animation_and_movers.md:2103-2107) -- so StartSequence 0x101a82d0 warns, writes m_nSequence := 0 (0x101a833d), m_flCycle := 0 and ResetSequenceInfo 0x10090950 plays the model's sequence 0 at rate 1.0; (2) the OnBeginSequence wire is authored 'AsianVamp,SetRelationship,player D_HT 5,3,-1' (sm_vamparena.bsp, Unofficial Patch and retail alike): a 3.0 s delay, so the input lands ~3 s after the output, after the scene has ended, and is expected last. Corrected 2026-10-04 (V4a integrator, N19 / J1): row 0 is the body's RawIndex 0 clip, played at rate 1.0 with its own loop bit. On AsianVampire.mdl sequence 0 IS prefight_bow (98 frames at 30 fps, ~3.2 s), so the missed lookup lands on the very clip the mapper meant and the scene now lasts its length: the 3.0 s wire of (2) lands INSIDE the scene, one think before the finish flag (DispatchAnimEvents 0x10091880 raises m_bSequenceFinished once m_flCycle + 0.1 s x cycle rate reaches 1, i.e. ~3.1 s after the play), so `flips` is expected before `played`. Measured: OnBeginSequence and 'seq 0 rate=1' 7.317, SetRelationship 10.317 (= 7.317 + 3.0), seqfinished 10.367, OnEndSequence and the release 10.483 (TASK_PLAY_SCRIPT's next think).
notes: The never on OnBeginSequence before 2.5 s pins retail's order (the output fires on the mark, not at the input; 0003 spec § 'The port today'). The taskfail never excludes one text, 'No Target (0x1)': after the release AsianVamp (is_bossmonster) selects SCHED_VASIANVAMPIRE_JUMP_UP (0x15a), whose task_vasianvampire_find_ledge_node fails 'No Target (0x1)' because the arena stages none of sm_vamparena's ledge nodes (10.483, the release's own instant, since V4a) -- staging, not the scene; a window cannot close at a label, and a 'No Target' inside the scene would break the ordered expectations on its own. `played` is within 0.5 s of `flips`: 3.0 s (the wire) against ~3.1 s (the clip less the 0.1 s look-ahead, 0x10091880).
